summary: 3-subset 4-block K=512 sweep ([1,2,4,7], [1,4,7,8], [1,2,7,8]) adapted from cycle 245 template with two-phase protocol: phase 1 single-seed sweep, phase 2 3-seed rerun if any subset best_ppl < 50.0.

Direct test of cycle 250 count-driven story; clean discriminator vs the asymptotic alternative

Helpers (CompressedMLP, fit_block_lstsq, eval_ppl, run_seed) reused verbatim from cycle 245
concerns: Phase 2 worst case (all 3 subsets trigger) reaches ~27 min, at the cap
Phase-1-only subsets have no seed std; phase-1 best ~52 (between thresholds) yields INCONCLUSIVE on a single observation
